humanTitle: People are stopped by errors that explain nothing at all
whoItAffects: Android and iPhone users in the United States and Canada, across three app versions.

build.proposition: An error that names the step, the cause and the retry.
specifics: Give each failure path its own message rather than one shared string
Say whether retrying will help, and after how long
Start with the sign-in failure that survives a reinstall
build.limitation: Specific errors leak how a system works, which is why teams default to one vague string.

start.proposition: Error-message review as a service for product teams.
specifics: Audits the failure paths a team never sees itself
Delivered as a rewritten set rather than a report
start.limitation: It is the kind of work teams believe they can do themselves, and usually postpone.

study.proposition: What does a generic error cost in abandoned actions?
specifics: Compare completion after a specific message versus a shared one
study.limitation: This needs production traffic, so it can only run inside a company that already has the problem.

write.proposition: The error message as a design decision, not an accident.
specifics: Collect the same vague string across several products
Use the reviews where reinstalling changed nothing
write.limitation: Error writing has a small literature already; the angle is what the vagueness protects.
